title: Evaluating and Rewarding Teamwork Using Cooperative Game Abstractions
reasoning: The paper focuses on applying cooperative game theory to evaluate team performance and fairly reward contributions. While fairness is discussed, it is from a mathematical/game-theoretic perspective (Shapley Value) rather than a broader ethical or moral framework. The Broader Impact section mentions potential biases in data and estimators, but this is a brief, standard consideration and not a central component of the research.
